name: html-split-layout-stylesheet-grid-native-layout
description: A two-pane container whose class name trips the split-layout columns heuristic (hero-grid) and whose cascade resolves display:grid with two equal tracks stays a core/group with a native grid layout (columnCount 2), never core/columns. core/columns is a flex layout: pairing it with layout:{type:grid} serializes the wp-block-columns + is-layout-grid combo WordPress rejects.

source_reference.notes: Derived from a bakery hero where .hero-grid { display:grid } held exactly two panes (copy + plate figure); the split-layout heuristic claimed it as columns while a native grid layout was stamped, producing an invalid block.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.
